name: kernel
description: Local-first coordination for separate project identities, safe execution, provider routing, and evidence-based verification.

interface.longDescription: KERNEL maintains a file-based work board, explicitly registers independent projects, discovers dependency-ready tasks, routes safe work through local and free providers, and records reproducible verification evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KERNEL to inspect the canonical work board, select the next safe task, route it through the lowest-cost capable provider, and verify the result.
